method: Installed image tool edited the inherited wall; selected only generated ochre, chalk and charcoal pigment within the previously bare rectangle. Every pixel outside it was copied unchanged from wall-v17.
visualReview: Inspected the full PNG and JPEG. A small worn ochre circle holds three chalk stones on the right side. The inherited Pepe has a wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes; each unchanged hand has five digits, four fingers and a thumb. No new hands or handprints. Rock texture, cracks, crystals, torchlight, framing and all ancestral marks remain. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed.
deliveryNote: The explicitly required JPEG beside the record is the only new picture outside artifacts/, resolving the brief's conflicting picture-location rules in favor of the named output path.
